title: PH bracing for P20-B losses from El Niño

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine agriculture sector may incur P20 billion in losses due to a potentially strong El Niño expected by early 2027, according to the Department of Agriculture (DA). “With values up now and it is a super El Niño, we expect losses to reach P20 billion,” Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. […]...
